title: META-SIGNAL-2: drain the site meta:* KV records through foundation/metasignal.py and file META-<n> roadmap issues
body:
**Owner:** Product manager
**Trigger:** tick Worker clock, daily
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::metaDrain
**Status:** closed

META-SIGNAL-1 ships the detectors (doctrine/meta-loop.json, foundation/metasignal.py), the site beacon (site/interview.js mic events) and the ingest route (POST /api/meta/ingest, KV meta:<iso>:<id>). This item adds the server-side drain: the tick Worker lists meta:* keys, runs mic-event and text detectors, appends docs/meta/signals.jsonl and files META-<n> issues past the thresholds, then reports the signals per week as a metric. Also wire session transcripts and owner chat into the same ingest. Closing probe: a mic-event posted to the live route appears as a signal within 24 h and three of the same code file one META issue.

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::metaDrain

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 175.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
